facebook.long_form:
Tonight is the one everyone has been circling on the schedule.

Oklahoma hosts USAO tonight at Love's Field in Norman — 6:30 PM CT, streaming free on 1oklahoma.com. After four Battle Series intrasquad games this fall, tonight marks the first time the 2027 Sooners take the field against an external opponent. And if the Battle Series is any indication, this is going to be a good show.

Kendall Wells has been one of the most electric players in college softball since the moment her freshman season began. After 39 home runs and NFCA Freshman of the Year honors last spring, she has carried that momentum into fall ball — including another home run in Game 4 last Tuesday. Tonight she gets a real opponent in front of her.

Haley Kavan returns for a graduate season after becoming a two-time WCWS Most Outstanding Player. Jocelyn Berzon — who came over from LSU with a 52-25 career record across three seasons — gives Oklahoma a second dominant arm in the circle. Those two, alongside the rest of the returning core, make Oklahoma one of the most complete programs in the country before a single spring pitch has been thrown.

Admission is free on the stream. Set your reminder: 6:30 PM CT tonight on 1oklahoma.com.

stories.title: Tennessee Fall Finale TONIGHT — Free at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium

x_posts.label: Post 2

vs Lee University — Sherri Parker Lee Stadium — 6 PM ET — FREE

Karlyn Pickens (194 K, 1.70 ERA) and Sage Mardjetko (16-3, 1.26 ERA).

The best pitching staff in the SEC takes the field one last time this fall.

#Tennessee #GBO #Softball

facebook.long_form:
Tennessee's 2026 fall season closes tonight, and if this autumn is any preview of what's coming in the spring, Lady Vols fans have a lot to be excited about.

Tonight's opponent is Lee University at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium in Knoxville — first pitch 6:00 PM ET, free admission. It is the final public look at this Tennessee team until February.

The headline is the pitching staff. Karlyn Pickens — the No. 1 pick in the AUSL Draft, 194 strikeouts and a 1.70 ERA — is the best college pitcher in the country. Sage Mardjetko backed her up with a 16-3 record and a 1.26 ERA, earning NFCA All-American recognition. That combination is as formidable as anything Tennessee has produced, and both are back in 2027.

Head coach Karen Weekly has added a piece that changes the offensive trajectory of the program, too. Ehren Earleywine joined the staff as associate head coach and hitting coach — coming directly from the Texas program that won the 2026 national championship. His track record of developing hitters at the highest level is exactly what Tennessee needed to pair with its dominant pitching.

The Lady Vols entered tonight having gone at least 3-0 in their fall games. Tonight's finale against Lee University closes a fall that has made Tennessee one of the most-discussed programs in 2027 national title conversations.

Get to Sherri Parker Lee Stadium or watch on UT Sports — and enjoy one of the best pitching staffs in program history for the last time this fall.

facebook.long_form:
Florida's fall resume speaks for itself.

A 20-0 win over Santa Fe. A 29-1 destruction of Carson-Newman. Forty-nine runs across two games. Sophia Edwards with three home runs in those contests alone. This is a Gators program that has looked every bit like a national title contender this fall, and today they play again.

Florida hosts UNF this afternoon at Katie Seashole Pressly Stadium in Gainesville — free admission for anyone who wants to come watch. It is the Gators' third fall game, and with six starters returning for 2027, there is plenty to evaluate and appreciate about where this program is heading.

What makes Florida especially dangerous for 2027 is the combination of experienced players and pitching depth. Head coach Tim Walton's teams have long been built around pitching and defense, and the returning staff — combined with the talent already committed in the 2028 class — suggests a program that is only getting better.

Today is another free chance to watch one of college softball's elite programs up close. Take advantage of it.

x_posts.label: Post 4

2028 Extra Elite 100 Top 5 drops THIS MONDAY.

• 1,200+ players nominated — largest class ever
• Contact window: TOMORROW (Oct 24-25)
• No. 1 overall still up for grabs

The 2028 recruiting cycle peaks this week. #Softball #Recruiting

facebook.long_form:
The biggest recruiting story in college softball reaches its climax this week.

Extra Inning Softball's 2028 Extra Elite 100 has been releasing ranked players for weeks now — from No. 100 all the way down. The class is the largest ever evaluated: more than 1,200 players were nominated. The top team programs — Florida, Texas, Oklahoma — have already secured several of the top-ranked prospects. But the most-anticipated moment is still coming.

The Top 5 reveals Monday, October 27.

Who lands the No. 1 overall spot? The current picture has Michaela Landers, a Texas commit, as the consensus top infielder. Florida commit Kylie Holden is rated No. 2 overall by Softball America. OU commit Schlader sits at No. 3. The players in the top five will define the landscape of 2028 recruiting — and the programs that land them will have a major head start on the competition.

Before Monday's reveal, the next NCAA contact window opens tomorrow — October 24 and 25. Expect another wave of commitments to follow. Coaches who have been watching prospects all fall have their targets identified, and the next 48 hours will reshape the 2028 landscape before the Top 5 even drops.

The 2028 class is setting up to be historic. This week is when it gets official.

stories.title: What Fall Ball 2026 Taught Us About the 2027 Title Race

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
Fall ball ends this week. The 2027 title picture is taking shape:

OU: Wells + Kavan + Berzon
Florida: 49 fall runs, 6 starters back
Tennessee: Pickens + Mardjetko
TTU: Pickering + portal class

Something great is coming. #Softball #NCAASoftball

facebook.long_form:
Two months of fall ball are nearly over. Here is what 2026 has taught us about the 2027 national title race.

Oklahoma is built for it. Kendall Wells (39 HR, NFCA Freshman of the Year) has continued to be electric in fall ball. Haley Kavan — back for a graduate season as a two-time WCWS MOP — anchors the lineup. Jocelyn Berzon gives coach Patty Gasso a second dominant arm behind Kavan. Finlee Williams, the top-ranked outfielder in the 2027 class, is joining the program. There is no obvious weakness.

Florida is the other team that consistently looks like a champion. Forty-nine runs in the first two fall games. Six starters back. Sophia Edwards emerging as an offensive force. A top 2028 recruiting class already locked in. The Gators have the talent to make a deep run in June.

Tennessee is the dark horse that is quietly becoming a co-favorite. Karlyn Pickens and Sage Mardjetko are as good a 1-2 punch as exists in the sport. Adding Ehren Earleywine as hitting coach from Texas's 2026 championship staff addresses the one area where Tennessee has lagged behind. If the offense takes a step forward in 2027, the Lady Vols have the pitching to win a national title.

Texas Tech is the program nobody should overlook. Kasidi Pickering — .384 BA, 50 HR, 169 RBI over three seasons at Oklahoma — gives the Red Raiders an elite bat. The full portal class (Heavener, Polar, Gallaway) and a coaching staff featuring Jeff Cottrill and Shelby Pendley (84 HR, 269 RBI at OU) have turned TTU into a genuine Big 12 threat and a WCWS contender. Big 12 play starts March 12.

The 2027 national title race will not be decided on the fall ball field. But what happened from September through October has clarified who the serious contenders are. It is going to be a tremendous spring.
facebook.image_caption: Fall ball is almost over. The 2027 title race is coming into focus: OU, Florida, Tennessee, Texas Tech. Four programs. One national championship. See you in the spring. #Softball #NCAASoftball
